name: Question 3
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14041529/assets/37294502ac1c3c15790f5b820b2499fd03c16edb53b2faa90080507f3065eb84.png)

Describe the shaded region shown above using set-builder notation.

$$
{(x,y)\in {{field-1}}\,:\,{{field-2}}\le x\le {{field-3}},\,{{field-4}}\le y\le {{field-5}}}
$$
worked_solution:
A point $P(x,y)$ lies inside or on the rectangle's edges if the following conditions are satisfied:

$$
\begin{aligned}-1\le x\le 5,\,1\le y\le 3.\end{aligned}
$$

Moreover, since *every* real value in these intervals is included, $x\in R,y\in R,$ and therefore 

$$
(x,y)\in R\times R={R}^{2}.
$$

Therefore, we can write our set as follows:

$$
{(x,y)\in {R}^{2}\,:\,-1\le x\le 5,\,1\le y\le 3}
$$

EXPLANATION

A point P(x,y) lies inside or on the rectangle's edges if the following conditions are satisfied:

−1≤x≤5,1≤y≤3.

Moreover, since every real value in these intervals is included, x∈R,y∈R, and therefore

(x,y)∈R×R=R2.
